findings: All seven broad shapes are distinguishable across the two backgrounds at the reviewed CSS sizes. Scout/Interceptor give the clearest directional reading; Carrier twin rails, Fiber unequal round/square masses, Impact blunt visor, and Trapper open grid provide distinct cues.
At 24 pixels the interior fittings and thin connectors compress, especially Carrier/Fiber/Trapper. Orientation is less immediate for those shapes than Scout/Interceptor.
Pixelated sampling introduces visibly noisier small highlights at 24 pixels than Auto; no universal runtime sampling recommendation is inferred.
The source alpha composites without an opaque rectangular background in these captures. A few low-alpha fringe pixels and the many-color palette remain in exact source bytes.
limits: Static CSS samples only; no actual gameplay, rig, interpolation, collision, hitbox, physical device, memory-loading or performance validation.
Full-page output dimensions do not establish physical sprite size; the reviewed board source provides explicit CSS sizes.
No original image transformation, crop export, recompression or background rewrite. JPEG screenshots are native browser outputs retained byte-exact.
